evidence: mythkin-app/package.json declares exactly four runtime dependencies, all first-party Capacitor plugins: @capacitor/keyboard, @capacitor/preferences, @capacitor/share, @capacitor/status-bar. There is no advertising or analytics SDK among them.

A grep across every .js/.json/.swift/.plist in mythkin-app (excluding node_modules) for admob, google-mobile-ads, facebook, applovin, unity-ads, ironsource, appsflyer, adjust, amplitude, mixpanel, firebase, segment, posthog and sentry returns no SDK match. The only 'segment' hits are the English word in DESIGN.md and a CSS rule in app.css.
There is no iOS Podfile and no SPM package reference in mythkin-app/ios, so no advertising framework is linked into the native shell.
The app requests no advertising identifier: no AppTrackingTransparency usage, and no NSUserTrackingUsageDescription in the iOS Info.plist.

Verified 2026-08-10 for the FAQ's 'no account behind it: no email, no password' line: identity is a client-minted device UUID sent as X-Device-Id (mythkin-api/app/deps.py:32-45); mythkin-api has no auth routes, no email field, and no password anywhere — the schema's optional 'claimed by an account later' hook (deps.py:3-4) has no login surface behind it.

The subscription is bound by a separate iCloud-Keychain UUID (X-App-Account, mythkin-app/ios/App/App/MythkinPlus.swift:37-53), which is an identifier, not an identity — no personal credentials exist in either repo.

Full export and full delete ride the device id alone (mythkin-api/app/data_rights.py:1-34); deletion honestly retains anonymised shared kin, anonymised safety events and rate-limit counters, which is why the FAQ's delete answer carries the shared-kin caveat instead of claiming total erasure.
